I'm Neil Shah. By day I work on low-level systems software; the rest of the time
I'm a physicist trying to understand quantum field theory properly, which has
turned into a project of learning the mathematics underneath it: abstract
algebra, representation theory, Lie groups, and eventually the geometry of gauge
theory.

This site is where that learning gets written down. The [notes](index.qmd) are
atomic and linked, one concept at a time. The [book](book/index.html) is the
slower, linear write-up of the same material once it has settled.

## How the site is built

Plain Markdown files with LaTeX math, rendered by [Quarto](https://quarto.org)
and deployed by [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com) on every push to GitHub.
Theorem environments, cross-references and the bibliography are all native
Quarto features. The source is on
[GitHub](https://github.com/neilshahcosmos) if you want to see how any of it is
done.
